subject.title: feat(ui): show PR status on Claude threads

question: Should the shared session-catalog and plugin SDK permanently expose the provider-neutral optional `pullRequest` summary, rather than keep Claude PR metadata provider-local until another provider needs it?
rationale: This choice defines a reusable public plugin/protocol contract and cannot be settled solely from an otherwise coherent Anthropic implementation or contributor-authored approval note.

options.title: Approve the shared summary
options.body: Confirm `numbers` plus current `state` as the stable optional cross-provider contract and require focused protocol compatibility coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep it provider-local
options.body: Remove the shared protocol and SDK additions, rendering the metadata only through an Anthropic-owned path until a generic need is established.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared summary
recommendation.body: Confirm `numbers` plus current `state` as the stable optional cross-provider contract and require focused protocol compatibility coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed adjacent owner in the supplied history, though a current protocol/SDK owner should make the final decision.
